basics.name: Stanislav Natalenko
basics.label: CTO at BanQu Inc.
basics.summary: Engineering executive with 20+ years architecting distributed, event-sourced platforms from prototype to production scale. Currently CTO and Chief Architect at BanQu, leading the supply-chain transparency platform serving global enterprises. Inventor on granted US and European distributed-ledger patents and author of open-source toolkits for CQRS, Event Sourcing, and data transformation.

work.name: BanQu
work.summary: Owned architecture, product direction and delivery, leading a small distributed team of engineers and QA while influencing technical decisions across adjacent teams. Led hiring and maintained lightweight engineering processes. Designed and operated an event-sourced platform that processed 10M+ supply-chain events for global enterprise customers.

work.name: API Nation
work.description: Workflow automation and data-integration platform for the real estate industry
work.summary: Designed and built the processing core of the integration platform: a set of orchestrator services on AWS Lambda and RabbitMQ that process large data volumes in parallel, on demand.

work.name: SpiderSuite
work.description: Cloud and mobile inspection management platform for commercial real estate lenders
work.summary: Co-founded the company and took the product from an idea to a production platform serving the commercial real estate lending market. Owned architecture and UX for a message-driven, API-first platform, and set up its security, disaster recovery and multi-cloud failover across Azure and AWS.

work.name: SPS Commerce
work.description: Cloud supply-chain management and EDI network for retailers and suppliers
work.summary: After the acquisition, merged the Direct EDI and SPS Commerce engineering teams and led development of the SPS products transferred to the Ukraine office.

work.name: Direct EDI
work.description: Web-based EDI and supply-chain integration solutions. Acquired by SPS Commerce
work.summary: Led or built 5 of the company's 7 core products. Hired and ran a technology organization of about 20 people, managing some teams directly and others through their team leads, and moved it to Scrum along the way.

work.name: Direct EDI
work.summary: Planned and coordinated delivery between the San Diego PMO, enterprise customers and the development team in Ukraine.
